main.description: A member-authored consent evidence record for joining a cooperative or network. Active membership authority lives in the cooperative's group authority, not in this record.

cooperative.description: The DID of the cooperative or network the member is consenting to join.

consentType.description: The kind of consent evidence this record represents.

message.description: Optional member-authored note associated with the consent.

termsUri.description: Optional terms record the member consented to.

termsCid.description: CID for the terms record at signing time.

agreementUri.description: Optional agreement record associated with this consent.

agreementCid.description: CID for the agreement record at signing time.

invitationUri.description: Optional AT URI for an invitation record, when one exists.
